name: JsSafetyChecker
description: Run the JavaScript safety checker (AST-based duplicate function, duplicate HTML ID, syntax errors) against a file or directory. Returns findings.

target.description: Target directory or file to scan (default: cwd)

prompt.mandatory_instruction: Run JsSafetyChecker on JavaScript and HTML files in the workspace to validate syntax, duplicate functions, and duplicate IDs.
prompt.available_hint: Validates JS/HTML for syntax errors, duplicate functions, and duplicate element IDs
